deer:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated production creature sprite for a Chinese xianxia pixel RPG. Reference 1 is the OLD moss-antler deer for species identity ONLY, not its chunky pixel style. Reference 2 is the current game's fine-pixel material/detail reference.
Redesign a graceful adult moss-antler spirit deer: slender anatomically believable four legs, small gentle face pointing LEFT, branching warm ivory-brown antlers, chestnut coat with restrained pale spots and a small moss/jade foliage saddle along the shoulders. Moss must not look like a giant hedge. Elevated orthographic 2.5D game view, three-quarter side pose facing LEFT, all four hooves fully visible, natural calm stance. Match detailed retro pixel clusters and fine dark contour of current game, no cartoon/chibi proportions, no chunky voxel blocks or photorealistic rendering. Broad clean fur shade groups, warm tan highlights/cool teal-brown shadows, muted jade foliage, upper-left light.
Intended game body INCLUDING antlers 52 pixels tall, around 55 pixels wide; prioritize silhouette and clean readable feet over excessive fur noise. Genuinely transparent background, full creature centered with ample clear margin. No floor, ground shadow, landscape, people, UI, text, item icons or extra poses.
